execution_assumptions: Scheduled contribution at the next observed close within seven calendar days
Zero fees and zero slippage; quoted close does not guarantee fill
Buy and hold resulting shares; no external cash for rights
Provider source-history basis reconstructed using provider split ledger; official actions determine holdings
Current frozen universe creates survivor bias in historical evaluations
unresolved: Actual dividends and payment dates are not included in terminal cash
Rights record-date proxy exercise is not an executable subscription calendar
Bonus share credit delays and exchange settlement timing are not modeled
Parent-security drawdown is not combined parent-plus-resulting-company portfolio drawdown
prior_results: Earlier build-02 results used an incorrect nominal-price basis and unpurged training outcomes; they cannot establish comparative performance gains.
